Calculations: the engineer's path

Today the header holds 12h / 24h and Back to Investigation; the band holds the window, the verdict, the versions and Run details ↗; the list opens with two lines of labelled filters and a count; the panel says the verdict again, splits the unit over two rows and spreads three Workbench links under a heading with a ?. The page answers one question, what the engine computed on this window and how, so it gets no tabs: the band picks the loop and the window kind, the list says what was computed, the panel says how, and the foot names the window once.

BandLoop search ▾12h fused ▾● window verdict… Investigation ↗ (outlined)

Band

Which loop, which window, and what was its verdict?
  • Loop search first
  • 12h fused / 24h fused (was the header's 12h / 24h)
  • The window's verdict, once
  • Investigation ↗ at the far end

Calculations

What did the engine compute, and what did each gate make of it?
  • Search, Category, Gate, Result in one row, no labels
  • All 19 rows: name, ID · gate, value with unit, gate result
  • Sort by calculation or by gate result

Selected calculation

How is this value computed, and which gate judges it?
  • Value, Unit (the loop's unit), Gate with its result
  • Method: formula and one sentence
  • The stale-version warning when the value is older than the engine

Proof

Where is the evidence for this value?
  • Open G3 proof → (the gate's run in the Workbench)
  • Rules & parameters ↗, Identity & raw ↗: the same run, those tabs
  • Record details (a dialog)

Foot

Which window and which run wrote these values?
  • 12 h window · 6 Nov 10:45 → 22:45 UTC · 8,221 samples · Original run
  • Run details: gates, run, bundle, versions, build, computed, proof retained

What stays exactly

All 19 calculationsNo paging; name, then "CPLM-010 · G3"; value; gate result with glyph and word
No value is ever 0Not calculated / Insufficient data with the engine's reason; a window-wide reason once above the rows; the gate's result muted when the metric has no value ("Pass on other inputs")
SortingCalculation (ID, name A to Z, Z to A) and Gate result (needing attention first)
FiltersSearch, category, gate, result, same choices; the gate list narrows to the category; ?gate= in the address; Clear filters
The windowNewest fused window, or the exact one ?window= names; ?kind= and ?metric= in the address; "That window is not stored" with Show the newest window
WarningsWindow values unavailable, values not stored, window unavailable, verdict unavailable, stale version
Method for each calculationThe same formula and sentence
Open G3 proof →Primary at the panel foot; off with its reason when the gate has no run on the window
Run detailsGates tally, decision run, bundle, versions, engine build, computed, proof retained and its note
Below 1280 pxThe panel is a drawer a row opens. At 1000 px the band should fit one line, about 830 of 950 px (today it wraps to two)
SizesTwo-line 52 px rows and type as today; band and filter controls 32 px, as on the other redesigned pages

For the owner to decide

  1. Window choice in the band? The page shows the newest window, or the one a link names; it has no window list. The Workbench, Replay and Window Inspector have one with ‹ ›. Adding it adds a capability. Recommended: yes, the Workbench's list; the verdict then sits in that dropdown, as there. Not drawn in the sample.
    If yesLoop search ▾12h fused ▾6 Nov 22:45 · Oscillation confirmed ▾‹›… Investigation ↗
  2. The loop's unit in place of "PV units"? 1.988 kg/h, 85,666 kg/h·s, as System Response shows (CHG-165); "PV units" stays when no unit is registered. Recommended: yes.
  3. Run details is shared with Replay. Dropping Window, Result and Samples (both feet say them) and the readable Computed time changes Replay too. Recommended: yes, on both.
  4. Record details as a dialog? Today a closed disclosure that stretches the panel when open; Window Inspector opens its Record details as a dialog. Recommended: the dialog.
